text: Automation is a cross-disciplinary engineering specialty that integrates mechanical engineering, electronic technology, computer science, control theory, etc. Its core objective is to achieve "automation" in industrial production, social services and other fields through technological means - that is, to reduce human intervention and improve the efficiency, accuracy and stability of the system. Its application scenarios have expanded from traditional industries to cutting-edge fields such as intelligent transportation, robotics, aerospace, etc., and it is one of the core disciplines driving "intelligent manufacturing" and "Industry 4.0".
